citeinfo.title: 7.5 minute quad boundaries for La Jolla and La Mesa (San Diego County)

idinfo.native: Microsoft Windows 2000 Version 5.0 (Build 2195) Service Pack 2; ESRI ArcCatalog 8.4.0.1

descript.abstract: USGS 7.5' Quad Boundaries for La Jolla and La Mesa.
descript.purpose: This shapefile is intended to be used as the study area to which all other shapefiles will be clipped.
descript.supplinf: USGS 7.5' Quad Boundaries were downloaded from http://www.sandag.org/resources/maps_and_gis/gis_downloads/basemap.asp in interchange format (.e00). It was converted to shapefile then the quads for La Jolla and La Mesa were extracted using the Select tool.

timeperd.current: Source data was obtained from SANDAG

place.placekey: A portion of San Diego County
